mil7.5.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, vicchikassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.5.4:1.2: Yathā mahārāja vicchiko nangulāvudho, nangulaṃ ussāpetvā carati,
mil7.5.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ñāṇāvudhena bhavitabbaṃ, ñāṇaṃ ussāpetvā viharitabbaṃ.
mil7.5.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja vicchikassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.4:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Upasenena Vangantaputtena:
